name: Germany job seeker visa
info:
Eligibility for UAE Job Seeker Visa

To qualify, applicants need to meet certain criteria:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Age: Minimum of 18 years.
  • Professional Background: Work experience in a skilled field increases chances of approval.
  • Financial Proof: Sufficient funds to support stay.
  • Health Insurance: Mandatory medical coverage during the visa validity.
  • Clean Record: No criminal background.
